notes.title: Lunch Truck Tycoon 2 Now Available!
notes.notes:
Explore an Open World Simulation Tycoon game that puts you in control of a lonely Lunch Truck. Expand your franchise and become the Grandmaster of Lunch Island. Win all 12 competitions, earn the trophies for all 6 regions and find all of the hidden gems.

Dynamic Economy
Story Mode
Crafting
Upgrade your Truck
and much more…

http://store.steampowered.com/app/660120/Lunch_Truck_Tycoon_2/

notes.title: Version 2.3.2
notes.notes:
Change log 2.3.2
•	Added button to switch from full screen to windowed
•	Added mouse wheel scroll for menu and improvements
•	Bug fixed - Cook-off button was clickable during an active turn
•	Changed cook-offs feedback, customer feedback now goes in order, not random
